title: Auth project fragment
description: Project-schema fragment contributed by @jxsuite/auth: the `auth` section configuring Better Auth over a connector connection. Entries carry identifiers and env-var NAMES only — secret values live in .dev.vars locally and the platform secret store in production (specs/extensions.md §13).

auth.description: Authentication configuration. Enables the /_jx/auth mount (Better Auth) and the permission rules beyond "public"/"none" on data tables.

connection.description: Name of a `connections` entry holding the auth system tables (user, session, account, verification). Defaults to the project's first-declared connection.

secretEnv.description: NAME of the env var holding the Better Auth signing secret. The value itself is a secret and never enters project.json.

providers.description: Social sign-in providers keyed by Better Auth provider id ("github", "google", …). Values name the env vars carrying each provider's OAuth credentials; defaults are <ID>_CLIENT_ID / <ID>_CLIENT_SECRET.

clientIdEnv.description: NAME of the env var holding the OAuth client id.

clientSecretEnv.description: NAME of the env var holding the OAuth client secret.

redirects.description: Site paths the auth actions navigate to after auth state changes.

afterSignIn.description: Path to navigate to after a successful sign-in/sign-up.

afterSignOut.description: Path to navigate to after sign-out.

roles.description: Role names usable in table permission rules ("role:<name>"). Declaring any role adds a `role` column to the user table; assignments are edited via the data grid.

trustedOrigins.description: Extra origins allowed to call the auth routes (Better Auth trustedOrigins passthrough).
